I have a complete picture of the owner duplicate detection subsystem. Here is my report.

## Overview

Duplicate detection for owners lives entirely in the OfficeFloor `POST /api/owners` pipeline. There are **three separate duplicate checks** (telephone, email, household), each with its own function class, its own exception, its own handler, and its own escalation YAML. There is **no** consolidated `identityKey` and **no** persisted `normalizedTelephone` — those are only referenced aspirationally in the acceptance test comment. Duplicate detection is done by scanning `ownerRepository.findAll()` in memory; the repository has no `findByTelephone`/`findByEmail`/`findByHousehold` methods.

---

## 1. Duplicate-detection function classes

All under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`:

- **`EnsureTelephoneUnique.java`** — canonicalizes both sides to E.164 via `OwnerTelephone.toE164`, scans `findAll()`, throws `DuplicateTelephoneException(request.getTelephone())` on match. Falls back to bare digits if E.164 parse fails.
- **`EnsureEmailUnique.java`** — lower-cases/trims both sides, skips when email null/blank, scans `findAll()`, throws `DuplicateEmailException(request.getEmail())`.
- **`EnsureHouseholdUnique.java`** — compares normalized `lastName` (lower/trim/collapse-whitespace) AND normalized `address` (`OwnerAddress.normalize`); bypassed when `request.getSharesHousehold() == true`; throws `DuplicateHouseholdException(lastName, address)`.

Supporting normalization helpers (package-private `final` classes):
- **`OwnerTelephone.java`** — `static String toE164(String)`; strips `[\s()\-]`, assumes `+61` when no `+`, drops leading `0`, validates `\+[0-9]{8,15}`, per-country national lengths `61->9`, `1->10`.
- **`OwnerAddress.java`** — `static String normalize(String)`; trim/collapse/UPPERCASE + expands `ST->STREET, RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE`. Used by required-field check, household dup detection, and household-id derivation.
- **`OwnerEmail.java`** — `static String normalize(String)` throws `InvalidEmailException`; returns null when blank, else trimmed lower-cased, validates `^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$`.

Related (not duplicate, but same pipeline): `ValidateOwnerFields.java` (first step; normalizes address, telephone→E.164, email→lower, writes back to the `@Val OwnerFieldsDto`), `AssignHouseholdId.java` (post-check; derives `householdId = "H-" + first 12 upper-hex of SHA-256(normalizedLastName + "|" + normalizedAddress)`, back-fills peers, sets `householdSize`).

---

## 2. Duplicate/conflict (409) exception classes

Under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/`:

- **`DuplicateTelephoneException.java`** — `extends Exception`, holds `telephone`, ctor `(String telephone)`.
- **`DuplicateEmailException.java`** — `extends Exception`, holds `email`, ctor `(String email)`.
- **`DuplicateHouseholdException.java`** — `extends Exception`, holds `lastName` + `address`, ctor `(String lastName, String address)`.

Handlers (each sends `ResponseEntity<Map<String,List<String>>>` with `HttpStatus.CONFLICT`):
- `DuplicateTelephoneExceptionHandler.java` → body `{"errors":["telephone"]}`
- `DuplicateEmailExceptionHandler.java` → body `{"errors":["email"]}`
- `DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler.java` → body `{"errors":["lastName","address"]}`

Escalation registrations (each is a 2-line `handle: class:` file) under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/`:
- `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.DuplicateTelephoneException.yml`
- `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.DuplicateEmailException.yml`
- `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.DuplicateHouseholdException.yml`

(Other escalations in that dir: `CityAtCapacityException`, `DailyOwnerLimitException`, `InvalidEmailException`, `InvalidTelephoneException`, `MissingOwnerFieldsException`, `NotFoundException`, `DataIntegrityViolationException`, etc.)

---

## 3. Owner entity — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`

`@Entity @Table(name="owners")`, extends `Person`. Persisted fields (column → field):
- `address` (`@NotEmpty`), `city` (`@NotEmpty`)
- `telephone` — `@NotEmpty @Pattern(regexp="^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$", message="Phone number must be in E.164 form")`
- `email`
- `registration_date` → `registrationDate` (LocalDate)
- `customer_code` → `customerCode`
- `household_id` → `householdId`
- `household_size` → `householdSize` (Integer)
- `namesake_count` → `namesakeCount` (Integer)
- `bulk_signup_warning` → `bulkSignupWarning` (Boolean)
- `pets` (`@OneToMany`)

**There is NO `normalizedTelephone` field and NO `identityKey` field/column.** All the getters/setters exist for the above.

---

## 4. OwnerRepository

- Interface `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java`: methods are `findByLastName(String)`, `findByLastName(String, Pageable)`, `findById(int)`, `save(Owner)`, `findAll()`, `findAll(Pageable)`, `delete(Owner)`. **No findByTelephone/Email/Household.**
- Impls: `jdbc/JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`, `jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`, `springdatajpa/SpringDataOwnerRepository.java`.
- `SpringDataOwnerRepository` only overrides `findByLastName` (2 forms), `findAll(Pageable)`, `findById`. The duplicate checks rely on `findAll()` + in-memory scanning, not derived queries.

---

## 5. DTOs

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets and an
            optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by
            8 to 15 digits). A national number without a '+' assumes country code '+61' and drops a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only override for create. When true, the owner may be created even though an
            existing owner has the same lastName and address; when absent or false, such a request is
            rejected with 409. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

## Change: consolidated duplicate detection into a single `identityKey`

**New identity model** — `identityKey = normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId`. A create is rejected with **409 only when the new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing owner's**.

### Files added
- **`OwnerIdentity.java`** — single source of truth for the key and its parts: `key(telephone, email, householdId)`, `canonicalTelephone` (E.164), `normalizedEmail` (lower-cased, empty when absent), `normalizeName`, and `deriveHouseholdId` (SHA-256 → `H-…`).
- **`EnsureIdentityUnique.java`** — the one duplicate check. It computes the new owner's would-be household component (the derived id when an existing owner shares normalized lastName+address, else empty), builds its identityKey, and compares against every existing owner's key. Household peers are compared using the shared derived id so an exact full-key duplicate is still caught even before back-fill; everyone else uses their stored `householdId`.
- **`DuplicateIdentityException` / `…Handler`** + escalation YAML → 409 with `{"errors":["identityKey"]}`.

### Files changed
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — replaced the three steps (`ensureUniqueTelephone`, `ensureUniqueEmail`, `ensureUniqueHousehold`) with a single `ensureUniqueIdentity`.
- **`AssignHouseholdId.java`** — now delegates household-id derivation to `OwnerIdentity` so the assigned id and the check agree exactly.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `identityKey` property to the `Owner` schema (so it's **returned**).
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — populates `identityKey` from the persisted telephone/email/householdId.

### Files removed
The three `Ensure*Unique` functions and the `DuplicateTelephone/Email/Household` exceptions, handlers, and escalation YAMLs.

### Behaviour change (as specified)
Because telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household (same `householdId`) with **different telephones now have different identityKeys and are both allowed** — only an exact full-key match is a duplicate. The former standalone telephone/email/household rejections no longer apply independently.

**Test result:** `BUILD SUCCESS`, `AcceptanceTest.coreRejectsIdentityCollision` passes (a second owner reusing the first's telephone with no email and no shared household collides on the whole key → 409).

One note: the request-only `sharesHousehold` field remains in the OpenAPI schema but is now inert, since the single-key rule replaces the household-opt-in logic. I left the field in place to avoid changing the request contract; let me know if you'd like it removed too.
